changelog: Brand-new standalone app: the player is now fully separate from the website, which is a pure download page
Rebuilt isolation engine — 3-way crossover removes the centered voice from the mid band only, so bass below 130 Hz and highs above 9 kHz stay untouched
Adjustable isolation strength (0–100%) with live effect while music plays
Automatic stereo detection (channel-correlation analysis) with a smooth no-hole mono fallback
Library with songs, artists, playlists, favorites, search & sorting; up-next queue with shuffle & repeat
New now-playing screen, mini-player, sleep timer, playback speed and 5-band equalizer
WAV export (vocals / karaoke / your mix) saved directly to your device's Music folder
